sum_insured_options: ₹5L (illustrated); full range not explicitly stated in wording

room_rent.note: Base plan has no room rent limit. Optional add-on 'Room Rent Modification' can restrict to Single Private AC Room or Twin Sharing Room at lower premium.

icu.note: No separate restriction on ICU charges in base plan. ICU also uncapped even if Room Rent Modification add-on is opted.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Optional co-payment add-on available for premium discount. Smart Select add-on imposes 20% co-pay for non-network hospitals. True Connect add-on imposes 10% co-pay if hospital visited without prior network doctor consult.

sub_limits.note: Policy wording does not specify any disease/procedure-wise sub-limits in the base plan. All covered benefits payable up to Sum Insured.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Optional deductible add-on available for premium discount; amount as per Policy Schedule.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional 'PED Wait Period Modification' add-on can reduce this to a shorter period as per Policy Schedule. 'Instant Cover' add-on waives PED wait for Diabetes/Hypertension/Hyperlipidemia/Asthma from day 31.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Named ailments (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT surgeries, kidney stones, etc.) have 24-month waiting period. Optional 'Named Ailment Wait Period Modification' add-on can reduce this.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. New Born Cover optional add-on available but does not cover maternity expenses per se.

cumulative_bonus.note: Base plan: 50% of SI added per claim-free year, capped at 100% of SI. No claim impact on accrual. Optional 'Cumulative Bonus Super' add-on provides additional 100%/yr up to 500% of SI over and above base CB.

restoration.note: Unlimited Automatic Recharge reinstates full base SI unlimited times per policy year after base SI + CB + Plus Benefit exhausted. Usable for same or different illnesses.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered up to Sum Insured; no listed-only restriction.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI for treatment >3 consecutive days at home. Excludes 12 specified conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) inpatient treatment covered up to Sum Insured at registered AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's harvesting surgery expenses covered up to SI when insured is the recipient. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered.

ambulance.display: Covered up to SI (no separate cap)
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to Sum Insured as part of hospitalisation claim. Air ambulance available as optional add-on with limit as per Policy Schedule.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed advance technology methods covered (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions, etc.) up to Sum Insured. Other advance technology methods excluded.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items from List-I (Annexure I) are excluded by default. Optional 'Claim Shield' add-on makes these payable up to applicable SI.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only. No international/overseas cover available.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years (60 months), no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace period for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes; 15 days for monthly mode. Coverage not available during grace period (except instalment policies).

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period for new policies only; not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, infertility/IVF, hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomaly, refractive error <7.5D, non-listed advance tech methods, war/nuclear/bio/chemical

optional_riders.display: Claim Shield (consumables), Air Ambulance, Cumulative Bonus Super, Plus Benefit, Unlimited Care, PED Wait Reduction, Named Ailment Wait Reduction, Instant Cover, Room Rent Modification, Deductible, Co-payment, Smart Select, True Connect, Women Care, Mental Health, Annual Health Check-up, New Born Cover, Wellness, Be-Fit, Health Management Program
